setups.name: Wind Under
setups.why: Backed Under with 12+ mph wind forecast

setups.name: Backed Under
setups.why: Model under with a market or both-teams-low signal

setups.name: Big Under
setups.why: Model 4+ pts under the total, week 5 on (wind or not)

setups.name: Lucky Fade + QB Change
setups.why: Lucky Team Fade when either team's main QB didn't take most snaps last game. Works fading a lucky favorite or a lucky dog; the change is usually on the team we back. A side bet only: the total does nothing

setups.name: Bad-Weather Under
setups.why: Rain, cold (<35F), snow or wind 12+ forecast AND the model is under (Rain Under, 46-17, is folded in here: it was the same bet on fewer games)

setups.name: West Trip Fade
setups.why: Visitor flew 2+ time zones west; body clock

setups.name: Over-Streak Under
setups.why: Both teams went over the total in each of their last 2+ games: the market chases overs

setups.name: Moved-Our-Way Under
setups.why: Opener under whose total has dropped 0.5+ since: still bet it

setups.name: Model Favorite
setups.why: Our model has the FAVORITE winning by 4+ more than the opening line says: lay the points at the opener. Strongest on big favorites (14+) and against FCS teams; the mirror of the card's model underdogs

setups.name: Follow the 1H Total Juice
setups.why: 1H total priced 25+ cents lopsided: bet the expensive side

setups.name: Shootout Under
setups.why: Total of 70 or more: the market overprices shootouts

setups.name: Strong Dog
setups.why: Underdog the model backs, 4+ pts off the line

setups.name: September Under
setups.why: Weeks 1-2: offenses start slow

setups.name: Gusty Under
setups.why: Wind gusts 30+ mph forecast at kickoff

setups.name: Lucky Team Fade
setups.why: Bet against a team at +1.5 turnovers/game

setups.name: 1H Dog Edge
setups.why: Model 2+ off the 1H line, 3+ off the full line, its side is the 1H dog

setups.name: Models Agree
setups.why: Both of our market models (a linear model and a tree model, built differently on the same inputs) expect this side to beat the OPENING line by 3+ points. Paper: tracked at 0u at the opener

setups.name: 1H Model Edge
setups.why: Model 2+ off the 1H line and 3+ off the full line

setups.name: Calm Low-Total Over
setups.why: Total of 48 or less in a dome or with wind forecast 8 mph or less: a low total assumes a low-scoring game, but nothing is holding scoring down. The mirror of the weather unders (low totals in 12+ mph wind go UNDER 60%); NFL dome totals of 41 or less go over 60% too

setups.name: Extra 1H Points
setups.why: 1H spread 1.5+ pts off its usual share of the full spread: take the points

setups.name: Favorite Points Over
setups.why: Model on the favorite by 3+ and over by 5+

setups.name: Model Team Under
setups.why: Model 2+ pts under this team's total (not in Power-vs-G5 games)

setups.name: Dog Points Over
setups.why: Model on the dog by 3+ and over by 5+

setups.name: Strong Dog 1H
setups.why: This week's B dog (Strong or Lean Dog): take it in the first half too

setups.name: Snow Favorite
setups.why: Snow forecast: favorites cover (the better team handles it)

setups.name: Lucky Team's Opponent Over
setups.why: Opponent of a turnover-lucky team: its team total over

setups.name: Big Under -> Team Under
setups.why: Big Under game: team total under on the team the model is lower on

setups.name: Moved-Our-Way Dog
setups.why: Opener dog whose line moved 0.5+ our way since: still bet it

setups.name: Snow Under
setups.why: Snow forecast during the game

setups.name: Week 1 Home Dog
setups.why: Week 0/1 home underdog: early lines lean too hard on last year and on brand names

setups.name: Kicking-Luck Fade
setups.why: Team kicking 1.5+ pts/game above expected; FG luck fades

setups.name: Big Under -> 1H Under
setups.why: Big Under game: first-half under too

setups.name: Lean Dog
setups.why: Underdog the model backs, under 4 pts off

setups.name: Boom-or-Bust Fade
setups.why: Lots of big plays but a low success rate: big plays regress
